# Radio Input

## Summary
A grouped radio control where the whole option area is the hit target.

## Shape
Renders a fieldset with `@groupDescription` as its legend and yields each of `@items`, so the
label, description and any rich content sit inside the clickable region rather than beside it.
`@checkedId` and `@keyName` identify the selection, `@orientation` and `@spacing` shape the
group, and `@invalid` with `@errorMessage` covers the error state. `@hideRadio` and
`@hideBorder` allow a card-style selection that keeps native radio semantics — so keyboard
arrow traversal and form submission still behave as expected.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/radio-input/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { RadioInput } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
